content: A tempo-synchronised step sequencer driving a click-free amplitude envelope, with a resonant filter swept by the same gate. Each step carries a continuous level from closed to open, not a switch, so the same instrument works as a hard trance gate or a rhythmic volume sequencer depending only on how the pattern is drawn. The grid is fully keyboard- and screen-reader-operable. Ships with 226 factory presets. Normally $29, FREE for Black Friday - download and activate by 30th November. title: PULSEDUCK 侧链闪避效果器（黑五限时免费）
summary: 插入式侧链闪避（ducking）插件，不是压缩器：闪避深度由手绘曲线决定，而非从输入电平推导，因此每次触发都一致；可用 Host / Sidechain / MIDI 三种方式触发，既能处理整个信号，也能只让分频点以下的内容闪避、保留低频谐波与音符清晰度；内置 16 条曲线并可自行绘制。原价 $29，黑五限时免费，需在 2026 年 11 月 30 日前下载并激活。跨平台：macOS 10.15+（AU / VST3 / AAX，Universal）与 Windows 10+ 64 位（VST3 / AAX）。
content: An insert ducker, not a compressor: every hit ducks identically. The depth of ducking is drawn as a curve rather than derived from the input's own level, which makes it a rhythmic tool rather than a dynamics one. Place it on a bass, synth, pad or effects return to step that signal out of the way of the kick - either the whole signal, or only the content below a fourth-order crossover, so a bass can lose its sub around the kick while its harmonics and note definition stay put. Three ways to decide when: Host mode runs a free-running envelope against the musical grid, Sidechain mode fires one shot per detected transient, and MIDI mode fires one shot per note-on. Sixteen original curves ship with it, plus your own drawn curves. Zero latency by default. Normally $29, FREE for Black Friday - download and activate by 30th November. 2026 年 11 月 27 日，Newfangled Audio 正式推出 Obliterate 插件的升级版 Obliterate 2：一款免费的极端失真滤波器 + 粗粝质感塑造器。

Obliterate 最初只是一个滤波器，但代码中的一个错误意外产生了猛烈的失真。我们本可以修复这个错误，却选择为它加入更多滤波器，然后把它释放到世界上。

Obliterate 2 保留了初代的 TOO MUCH 和 TOO MOST 算法，新增六种失真算法、五种噪声算法、一款可调谐的共振混响，以及丰富的调制功能。它由此从一款简单的失真效果器，进化为塑造粗粝质感与独特氛围的声音工具。

Obliterate 为你的音轨注入颗粒感、灼热感与原始能量。它不只是破坏声音，更要激发声音的潜力、挑战声音的边界，将它推向出乎意料的精彩境地。无论你想掀起一场声音风暴，还是只为音色增添一丝锋芒，Obliterate 都能让你的声音成为焦点。

你可以细致掌控，也可以放手肆虐。无论如何，Obliterate 都能让你的音乐响亮而清晰地表达自己，再添上几分恰到好处的低吼。

两种极端、夸张且可调谐的数字失真算法 ：TOO MUCH 和 TOO MOST。

六种相对温和的可调谐失真算法 ：HOT、CRUNCH、BITE、WARM、DARK 和 DIRTY。

五种 DESECRATION 噪声算法 ，为声音增添颗粒与脏感：GRIT、GRIME、BIT、HISS 和 DISINTEGRATE。

可调谐的 DIVINATION 混响 ，既能产生丰厚的调制混响尾音，也能打造带有梳状滤波特征的扭曲音效。

氛围与个性塑造 ：为平淡乏味的输入信号增添独特氛围与音色个性。

可调制的频率与共振控制 ：滤波器、失真和混响均内置频率与共振参数，并支持调制。

两个多模式共振滤波器 ，可在低通、高通、带通、全通和陷波模式之间连续渐变。

A→B 参数渐变 ：自动化两组设置之间的过渡，也可使用 LFO、包络或侧链控制渐变。

直观的拖动控制 ：只需点击并拖动，即可同时调整所有频率与共振参数。

两年前的感恩节，我们发布了免费插件 Obliterate。当时，家人的健康传来了一些坏消息，加上世界上发生的种种事情，让我心中积蓄了不少愤怒。Obliterate 中那极端而猛烈的失真，正是这种愤怒的体现。

此后的几年里，我又经历了更多情绪：更多的愤怒、悲伤，甚至也有了一些希望。音乐很大程度上关乎情感，因此，我想借这个感恩的时节，为 Obliterate 带来更丰富的情感色彩。

我喜欢在感恩节表达对生活中所拥有的一切的感激。除了家人和朋友，最让我感恩的是，我能够设计音乐工具，而你们会用这些工具创作音乐。我由衷地感谢你们。

所以，我想说：谢谢你们支持我们，也谢谢你们始终坚持创作音乐，过着充满创造力的生活。你们正在让这个世界变得更美好。感恩节快乐。我们希望 Obliterate 2 能为你带来灵感。

—— Dan Gillespi e

HoRNet Plugins is offering HoRNet DynEQ , its single-band dynamic equalizer for macOS and Windows, for free again.

In short, DynEQ is a streamlined dynamic EQ that lets you target a frequency and apply the cut only when the signal crosses the threshold.

You get one parametric band with frequency, gain, and Q controls. It covers 20 Hz to 20 kHz, with up to 15 dB of boost or cut. To work on several problem areas, you can load another instance after the first.

Auto Speed follows your DAW’s tempo, while Auto Threshold adjusts the threshold relative to the incoming signal. You can, of course, leave those tasks to the plugin or set the speed and threshold yourself.

Both plugins mimic the keypad-driven workflow of early digital rack effects. As for the sound, the developer describes them as his own interpretations of the hardware, based on publicly available manuals and specifications.

KNS16 has 18 programs, covering rooms, halls, plates, chorus, echo, reverse effects, and freeze. You can enter settings with the keypad, nudge values up or down, and save nine user settings. The low and high decay filters let you tighten the bass or darken the tail, depending on the selected program.

Honestly, I’m not a fan of this keypad-style workflow, as I much prefer knobs and sliders for adjusting sounds. But it’s not too hard to get used to, and the benefit is that you can enter the exact values that you need.

By the way, it’s worth noting that KNS16 starts fully wet by default, which is handy for a send/return channel. If you insert it directly on a track, make sure to lower the Dry/Wet parameter in your DAW to bring the original sound back in.

Knightverb 2000 offers six programs with ten variations each, including halls, chambers, plates, and inverse rooms. Rich Plates have a wider character, while Rich Splits processes the left and right channels through separate reverbs.

Vibe Together is a free-to-start browser music sandbox where up to eight people can build a song together on a shared grid.

In Vibe Together, you place musical objects on the grid, connect them with wires, and watch signals travel between them to trigger sounds. The distance between objects determines the timing, so moving a note changes when you hear it. Pitch is represented by color, letting you follow a melody visually as it plays.

You can build a repeating loop or give different branches a chance of playing, so the pattern changes as it goes around. The procedural music system uses your key, scale, and chord progression to generate notes, with editable rules for how melodies move and resolve.

For example, set a rhythm branch to play 70% of the time, and it won’t appear on every pass. You can keep rearranging the connections while the music plays and hear how each change affects the result.

Umami Audio 限时免费送出 Personal Soup — Headphone Calibration 授权。该工具旨在为音乐制作人与音频工程师提供更平直、可靠的耳机监听响应，同时保留耳机原有的声音特性。
